urbanization_061.population_method: Move existing peasant households within their own kingdom; redistribute urban workforce. Country totals unchanged.

shatter_maw_067.note: 0.6.7 moves the Shatterfin crown to the north-west and enlarges it, and adds Cinderstep, a Cindermaw island between them. New Shatterfin locations are settled from existing Shatterfin towns; Cinderstep's settlers are new population added to Cindermaw. Shatterfin then outgrows Giltfang in land and towns: eight more towns on the enlarged main island, with new settlers (additions).

start_balance_067.note: 0.6.7 start-game balance: many more goblins, mostly tribesmen (40% of every location), who eat no food, pay little tax and settle into peasants over time; thinner luxury industry; a food source in every province; seeded trade between the three markets. Applied by tools/start_balance_067.py.
